name: io.github.rubatoyd/na-openapi-mcp
description: National Assembly Library of Korea catalog search (books, theses, articles, bills)

environmentVariables.name: NA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: data.go.kr OpenAPI key for the National Assembly Library search service (dataset 15098174). Required.

environmentVariables.name: NA_OS_TRUST
environmentVariables.description: Use the OS trust store for TLS (1=on, default). Set 0 to disable. Needed on school/corporate networks that intercept SSL.
